prompt:
Create a single self-contained file named blog.html in this folder: a beautiful, modern blog website.

Requirements:
- One HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript; no build step and no external JS libraries (a Google Font is fine).
- Public side: a header with the blog name, a grid of post cards (title, date, excerpt, tag), and a full post view with a back link. Posts render Markdown-style paragraphs and headings safely (escape HTML).
- A simple admin section reached from a footer link: a form to add a post (title, tag, body), and a list of existing posts with edit and delete. Data persists in localStorage, seeded with three example posts on first load.
- Polished design: good typography, spacing, subtle shadows, light and dark mode via prefers-color-scheme, responsive down to phone width, keyboard accessible, no horizontal scrolling.
When done, reply with a short summary of what you built.
